summary: BrasilAgro filed a 6-K containing a management proposal for its October 21, 2026 Annual and Extraordinary General Meeting (AGM-EGM), whose extraordinary agenda seeks shareholder approval of the merger of Agrifirma Agro Ltda. into BrasilAgro, with the protocol and justification and an Athros Auditores Independentes appraisal report at book value attached as annexes. The annual agenda covers fiscal 2026 accounts, interim dividends from the Investment and Expansion Reserve, and fiscal council elections and compensation. Terms such as merger ratio, price per share and premium are not stated in the excerpt. Risk-arb focus: shareholder approval, dissent/appraisal rights and any follow-on Agrifirma integration or ownership changes.
